EXPLANATION: The weak band at 3342 cm⁻¹ matches an N–H stretch (GFQ-002), and the strong band at 1601 cm⁻¹ is consistent with N–H bending (GFQ-002). Multiple C–H stretches around 2950–2850 cm⁻¹ (2949, 2870, 2845, 2796) fit aliphatic CH modes (GFQ-003). The intense 738 cm⁻¹ peak is compatible with CH₃ rocking on a dimethyl-substituted amine, and the 1458 cm⁻¹ band matches CH₃ deformation (GFQ-003). The 894 cm⁻¹ feature is near the expected N–H wag region for amines. Most other candidates lack N–H and thus cannot account for the 3342/1601 pair; dimethylamine (CN(C)N) is the most consistent.
